name: xingchi-session-keeper
description: magpie gateway middleware: automatically rotate sessions when XingChi (or any provider) hits its per-session request limit

summary.en: Automatically start a new session when a provider hits its per-session request limit. Works on top of providers you already use; no separate sign-in.
summary.zh: 供应商命中会话请求上限（如 XingChi 每会话 100 次）时自动换会话继续，挂在你已有的供应商上用，无需额外登录。
